status: Additional research comparison specified before inspecting its newly generated nuisance-shift outcome tables; original pilot/continuation/width findings were already known. Not an original-study preregistration.
question: Do task-fiber survival diagnostics improve held-out prediction of nuisance-shift degradation beyond gamma, achieved risk, conventional geometry, decoding, and variability-collapse baselines?
source_design: The existing 140 frozen OOD cells: four training conditions, seven gamma values, five paired training seeds.
checkpoint_rule: Reuse the first stored checkpoint at training loss <= 0.1; never retune learning rate or select using OOD outcomes.
independent_unit: Training seed; gamma and condition observations from a seed remain grouped.

comparison_models.design: Fixed condition-by-gamma cell indicators and actual achieved training loss.

representation_baselines.domain: The existing 100-by-100 IID latent grid for the same pure-nuisance task, with no OOD outcome used in feature construction.
representation_baselines.layer: Last hidden layer of the trainable branch; the centered model's complete predictor is still used for predictive evaluations.
representation_baselines.precision: float64 covariance calculations; relative eigenvalue cutoff 1e-10; rank-zero denominators are explicitly undefined and never imputed as collapse.
representation_baselines.trace_ratio: trace(Sigma_within)/trace(Sigma_between), reported under this descriptive name rather than mislabeled as a different neural-collapse statistic.

estimation.outer_validation: Leave one entire training seed out, five folds.
estimation.inner_validation: For each outer training set, choose ridge regularization by leave-one-training-seed-out validation using only the other four seeds.
estimation.standardization: Fit numeric centering/scaling on each training fold only. The design-cell encoding is fixed from the declared grid.
estimation.primary_score: Held-out mean squared error for each outcome; paired conventional-minus-fiber-added MSE per held-out seed.
estimation.uncertainty: Paired training-seed bootstrap, 2000 draws; report pointwise 95% and Bonferroni family-adjusted intervals for the three outcomes, together with every seed-level score.
estimation.missingness: Do not silently drop runs, change endpoints, or impute structurally undefined metrics. Report coverage and any consequent nonestimability.
estimation.interpretation: Prediction of held-out seed variation is an association result, not evidence that the diagnostic causes generalization. Five independent seeds limit precision. Null or negative added value is retained.

immutability: Any change requires a new version and an explicit reason; no revision is made to force incremental predictive benefit or novelty.
